newsitem.title: CHINA: Erdos Cashmere to issue new B shares.
newsitem.headline: Erdos Cashmere to issue new B shares.

text.p: The board of Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere has decided to apply to issue up to 100 million new B shares in China, the Shanghai Securities News reported on Saturday.
The decision was made at a meeting on Friday of the board of the company, the world's largest producer of cashmere based in the city of Dongsheng in Inner Mongolia, the newspaper said.
The company would use the proceeds from the issue to import equipment and machinery and set up five new companies to make cashmere goods. The remainder would be used as working capital, it said.
The company has applied to regulatory authorities for approval for the issue.
The company's B shares closed at $0.50 on the Shanghai market on Friday, up from $0.484 at Thursday's close.
